events.title: Survivors' Tournament: the results
events.summary: The Steam Next Fest Survivors' Tournament is over. Thank you to everyone who played, streamed or just watched: for 48 hours, the demo's leaderboards never stood still. events.title: Live on the store page: We Don't Exist at Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Every door leads back into the same white cube, rebuilt around a new trap, while a voice on the speakers grades your mistakes. During Steam Next Fest, we're showing gameplay from the free demo right here on the store page. Like what you see? Download the demo from this page, and add We Don't Exist to your wishlist: it's the best way to support a solo dev during the festival. The Survivors' Tournament runs in the demo until Wednesday, October 21 at 7 pm Paris time (17:00 UTC), in the EVENTS tab.

events.title: The Survivors' Tournament is now open!
events.summary: The Survivors' Tournament has begun! Until Wednesday, October 21 at 7 pm Paris time (17:00 UTC), launch the free We Don't Exist demo, open the EVENTS tab in the main menu and step into the trials. Five events: Survival, Survival for two, Labyrinth, Evacuation and the brand-new track THE GRINDER, revealed tonight. The best player in each event wins a key for the full game. events.title: Thank you. More than a thousand of you came inside.
events.summary: "The facility received more people than expected." Thank you The demo has passed one thousand downloads. For a one person studio, that is not just another number: it is a thousand doors pushed open, and far more than we hoped for when we released it. Your feedback did the work We received a lot of it, through the Contact us button in the menu, through the discussions on this page, and from those who took the time to record their visit. events.summary: "New survivors in the facility..." Thank you A huge thank you to everyone who pushed the facility's doors since the demo came out.
